_doc: HAND-WRITTEN companion of nav.json (#1320). nav.json, routes.json and targets.json are GENERATED by scripts/gen-navdata.mjs from the Android build.json ui declarations; this file holds only what Android cannot say. list_detail: sections that split into list + detail panes at the medium/expanded window classes (B.8; Android draws them single-pane on a phone). portals: fleet apps that are vendor UIs with no ui.sections; their /cloud-webapps/<app-id>/portal/ page frames the service when it allows framing (embeddable, decided by the portal probe test in M5) and otherwise shows the app card with an Open link. service = the service fallback page under /cloud-webapps/<service>/ the portal falls back to.
